transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well, nice to meet you too. My family says I'm here because I used up our savings on wood, lights, and display stuff. I kept pushing the work out there way after dark. But... I just felt like if I stopped, the whole house and the whole block would lose its chance.
Have you been hearing voices that other people can’t hear?
No, I haven't heard anything like that. Just the usual sounds around the neighborhood. Nobody talking to me or anything that isn't really there.
Did you believe you had a special power or mission to save the house or the whole block?

Well, I know people think I'm mixed up when I try to explain it. But it's not a magic power or anything like that. I'm just... I'm sure this neighborhood was picked for my last big civic art piece. That's what all the work was for. 

And I know I'm right because of the little things going on around the street. Like... when the trucks slow way down as they drive by, or the neighbors keep looking over at the yard. It proves they know it too. They know it's something important.
Have there been times when you believed the neighborhood was sending you signs like this even when your mood was not unusually high or energized?

No, it wasn't like that before. I mean, before I got so... charged up with all the remodeling plans and the art piece, I wasn't seeing any special meaning in the trucks slowing down or the neighbors looking over. None of that. Those signs... they really only started once I felt so driven to turn the house into this big civic project. Before that, a truck was just a truck.
Have you been hospitalized because of this?
No, I haven't been in the hospital for any of this. I've just been at the house, working on the project. Nobody's made me go to a hospital or anything like that.
Have you ever had a period of at least a couple of weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?

No, I can't say I have. I mean, sure, I get down sometimes like anybody else, but not for weeks at a time. And not all day, every day. I haven't really had any long stretches where I felt depressed like that.
During this time, have you been needing much less sleep than usual?

No, I can't say I have. I mean, I sleep about the same as I always do. I get my regular hours in at night. I'm not staying up all night or anything like that, if that's what you mean. Just... my normal sleep, really.
Before this current period, have you ever had another time in your life when you felt unusually high, energized, or driven like this?

No, I don't think so. I mean... I've had times in my life where I felt good, you know, got things done. But nothing like this. This is the first time I've ever felt this driven to work on something. I've never had a time like this before.
Has this period caused serious problems in your life, like major trouble at home, work, or with money?

Well, yeah, I suppose it has. The house... it's gotten really hard for my wife and me to even live in right now. I've got all my materials and these half-finished setups just taking over the rooms we actually need to use. And... well, people I care about are avoiding me. We've had some arguments about it all, and now they just steer clear. So, yeah, it's definitely causing some trouble at home.
